newsitem.title: POLAND: Rolimpex mulls convertible bonds issue.
newsitem.headline: Rolimpex mulls convertible bonds issue.

text.p: Polish food trader Rolimpex is considering issuing convertible bonds later this year to help it buy firms and equipment in the sugar, fats and grain industries, the firm's spokesman said on Wednesday.

"We're considering issuing long-term convertible bonds later this year but details aren't available yet," Bohdan Gornicki told Reuters. He said that at latest the firm's shareholders would vote on a proposal in June.

Rolimpex bought the Dobre and Ketrzyn sugar refineries last September and January respectively and seeks to buy shares in edible-fats makers such as Kruszwica, of which the treasury ministry has invited bids for a 40-percent stake.
Gornicki denied press reports that suggested Rolimpex might be mulling issuing shares later this year.
